history.referenceGeometry: Version 1 geometry remains in each world.referenceGeometry record, source-bound to its supplied reference picture; retained for history, never selected.
history.preCorrectionGeometry: Version 2 records remain in production-geometry-v2-preserved.json. They are historical and never selected; their old source fields do not substitute for current pixel/geometry review.
history.currentGeometry: Version 3 uses each retained independent generated map and its matching 16x10 source grid. Its source path and SHA are tied to the production image.
history.priorRuntime: Previous QA records show 11 of 12 example pictures had been bound as runtime backgrounds and geometry was treated as reference-bound. Those counts and approvals are historical and superseded.

migration.behavior: Preserves stable world IDs, resources, visits/discoveries, cache/site claims, resolved guards, and pending encounter packs. Relocates a saved hero only when the old cell is blocked or disconnected; remaps battle origin safely. Present malformed versions remain save errors.
